scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with tall buildings lining both sides, featuring a mix of residential and commercial properties, including a large white building with brown accents and numerous windows, as well as several parked bicycles along the sidewalk and a few pedestrians strolling by. The street itself is marked with white lines and has a bike lane, while the sky above is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The smaller buildings on either side add to the urban landscape, creating a sense of depth and texture.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt, featuring white markings and a bike lane, while the surrounding buildings have a mix of materials, including concrete, brick, and glass.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: Bicycles are parked along the sidewalk, with a few people sitting on them, while others walk by.
scene_analysis.vegetation: Trees line the sidewalk, providing shade and a touch of nature amidst the urban environment.
scene_analysis.signage: Signs are posted along the street, although the text is too small to read.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking along the sidewalk, with some stopping to sit on benches.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is bright and sunny, with shadows cast by the trees.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street appears quiet, with only a few people visible.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with shops and cafes, offering a range of amenities.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is bustling with students, with many bicycles parked along the sidewalk.
